reported.title: Wrong ADC-to-mm scaling
reported.description: averageMm() maps 0..1023 to 0..5000 mm, but the probe is 1 mV/mm with a 5 V reference, so full scale is 5000 mm only if the ADC reference is 5 V and the probe spans 0-5 V; the stated probe range is 4800 mm, so the divisor should reflect 4800 mm full scale (or the actual Vref), otherwise every reported level is ~4% high and the 4300 mm threshold trips early.

reported.title: Window not filled with real samples at power-up
reported.description: setup() zeroes readings[] then calls takeSample() 32 times, but total is never reset and the first 32 samples overwrite zeros correctly only because total starts at 0; however the initial fill happens back-to-back with no 30 ms spacing, so the 'first printed level' is a burst average, not a valid 32-sample window — and total is not cleared before filling, so any prior value would corrupt it.

reported.title: Lamp update only on sample tick, not within 1500 ms guarantee
reported.description: showLamp() is only called inside the 30 ms sample branch, which is fine, but the lamp uses averageMm() recomputed each time; the real issue is the threshold comparison uses the same mis-scaled average, so the lamp can be wrong by the scaling error and may not assert until the window fully reflects the change (~960 ms), which is within 1500 ms but combined with scaling error can miss the spec.

judge_input.spec:
- Level probe on A3 scaled at 1 mV per mm; high-level lamp on D5.
- Take one sample every 30 ms and average the last 32 into a level in millimetres. Fill the window at power-up so the first printed level is already valid.
- Print `bin <mm> mm` every 1000 ms; the printed level must stay within ±40 mm of the injected level.
- Drive D5 HIGH when the averaged level is at or above 4300 mm; otherwise LOW, within 1500 ms.
- The probe reads up to 4800 mm.
